newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZFOE bank bill futures volume up 37 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: NZFOE bank bill futures volume up 37 pct in 1996.

text.p: The number of 90-day bank bill futures contracts traded in 1996 on the New Zealand Futures and Options Exchange was up 36.9 percent on the previous year, exchange data released on Friday showed.
The number of contracts rose to 655,270 from 478,806. Volume for the month of December was 43,411, 9.6 percent higher than in the same month of 1995.
By contrast, annual volume in three-year bond contracts fell to 14,356 in 1996 from 26,912 in 1995, a drop of 46.7 percent.
The total annual volume in financial options fell 51.8 percent to 8,898, while share options volume rose 1.9 percent to 144,207. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
